Q1: Fluorescein presents a known oral hazard (Tier 1) and potential dermal and eye hazards (Tier 2). It shows a demonstrated low/moderate hazard for endocrine disruption, but data is deficient for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive hazards, environmental hazards, inhalation hazards, and organ/systemic hazards.
Q2: Fluorescein does not appear on any official lists of concern or low hazard. However, due to several data deficient (Tier 4) hazard classifications, this absence from concern lists may indicate a lack of comprehensive study rather than confirmed safety.
Q3: Fluorescein is a structurally well-defined chemical with an extensive body of scientific literature, well above the median for similar compounds. While it has some toxicological data, it has not undergone comprehensive EPA assessments (IRIS or PPRTV) and exhibits significant data deficiencies (Tier 4) in several hazard categories, indicating an incomplete hazard profile.
